lessons.content:
## ⚡ Platform Flow Verification Lesson

Welcome to the **LernexAI Fast-Track Test Course**!

This lesson is specially structured for fast end-to-end verification of the platform:
1. **Lesson Reading & Completion**: Click the green **"✓ Mark Topic as Complete"** button below.
2. **1-Click Quiz**: Answer the single question with the single option to instantly score 100%.
3. **Proctored Final Exam**: Complete the 1-question proctored final assessment (10-minute timer).
4. **Certificate Generation**: Preview, download, and verify your official LernexAI certificate!

All systems are operational.
